plan.contextChunk: This figure shows the complete DCGAN (Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Network) architecture as two mirrored pipelines labeled Generator (left) and Discriminator (right), each spanning one half of the figure and delineated by underbrace annotations. The Generator begins with a 100×1 latent variable z, passes it through a “Project and reshape” step to produce a 4×4×1024 feature volume, and then applies a series of fractional (transposed) convolutions with arctan activations that progressively upsample through 8×8×512, 16×16×256, 32×32×128, and finally a 64×64×3 output image. The Discriminator receives either a real image x or a generated image x*, starting at 64×64×3, and uses strided convolutions to downsample through 32×32×128, 16×16×256, 8×8×512, 4×4×1024, before a 4×4 convolution collapses the spatial dimensions to a 1×1 scalar that is passed through a sigmoid activation to produce the probability Pr(real). All feature volumes are rendered as three-dimensional orange-shaded parallelogram blocks, with black arrows indicating data flow. This figure introduces the DCGAN architecture, which replaces fully connected hidden layers with purely convolutional operations to produce and evaluate photorealistic images.

interactions.label: Network
interactions.teaches: The two pipelines are exact mirrors: the Generator grows spatial size while shrinking channels (4×4×1024 → 64×64×3), the Discriminator does the reverse (64×64×3 → 1×1). Switching makes the symmetry explicit.

interactions.label: Forward pass
interactions.teaches: A pulse travels stage-by-stage through the selected network, lighting each tensor and showing its shape, so the learner sees the data actually grow (Generator) or shrink (Discriminator) through each (fractional / strided) convolution.

Hovering any block reveals its exact tensor shape and the operation that produced it (project/reshape, fractional conv + arctan, strided conv, 4×4 conv, sigmoid), tying each visual block to its layer without cluttering the default view.

demo_steps.title: Generator forward pass
demo_steps.narration: The 100×1 noise vector z is projected and reshaped to 4×4×1024, then fractional convolutions with arctan activations upsample it through 8×8×512, 16×16×256, 32×32×128 to a 64×64×3 image. Watch the blocks get taller (more pixels) and thinner (fewer channels).

demo_steps.title: Discriminator forward pass
demo_steps.narration: A real or generated image x / x* enters at 64×64×3 and strided convolutions downsample it through 32×32×128, 16×16×256, 8×8×512, 4×4×1024; a final 4×4 convolution collapses space to 1×1 and a sigmoid yields Pr(real). The mirror of the Generator.

interactionPlan.geometry_notes: Oblique (cabinet) projection: every block's front face is a true axis-aligned rectangle (X = screen-right width, Y = screen-up height), depth recedes along one fixed up-right diagonal (Z = channels). World units per block (X×Y×Z): 4×4×1024 = 2.2×0.35×1.0; 8×8×512 = 1.1×0.6×0.8; 16×16×256 = 0.7×1.1×0.6; 32×32×128 = 0.5×1.8×0.45; 64×64×3 = 0.5×2.6×0.08 (image plane, near-flat). Latent z bar = 0.12×2.4×0.12 teal. Discriminator uses the same five block sizes in reverse left-to-right order, then two 1×1 teal cubes 0.12×0.12×0.12. Layout: Generator occupies x ∈ [-6.5, -1.0] (z bar at x≈-6.5, then 4×4,8×8,16×16,32×32,64×64 left→right with ~0.5 gaps); Discriminator occupies x ∈ [+1.0, +6.5] (64×64 leftmost at x≈+1.3, descending to 4×4 at x≈+4.6, 1×1 cubes at x≈+5.6 and +6.1). All blocks sit on a common baseline y=0. Colors: block front #d98a66, top #e8a07c, receding side #b5623f; latent & 1×1 teal #7fc4bd (side #5aa79f); image plane light photo-grey #cfd2d6; arrows & text & underbraces black #111. Dimension labels float ~0.3 above each block top. Forward-pass animation = sequential emissive pulse (front face brightens to #ffd9a0) moving left→right over ~1.2 s per stage, with the active stage's dimension label bolded.
interactionPlan.notes: Build each block as a BoxGeometry with three materials (front/top/side) for the oblique shading; shear the depth axis by translating the back face up-right rather than rotating, to keep front faces true rectangles. Keep both networks in the scene graph and toggle group visibility on the 'network' toggle; restart the forwardPass animation timeline whenever the toggle changes so the pulse always matches the visible pipeline. Render flow arrows as flat black arrow meshes on the baseline plane; render underbraces as a thin black curved line + centered title text sprite. Use a Sprite/HTML overlay for the per-stage dimension labels and the hover tooltip so text stays crisp and screen-facing.
